candidates.value: Analyze Lrrc8a KO vs WT as the request's 'exercise' comparison
candidates.reason_rejected: genotype contrast in cultured C2C12 cells, not an exercise intervention; would misstate the estimand
treadmill test is a running-distance phenotype; no RNA was sequenced from exercised animals

candidates.value: Use stretch stimulation (S4.12.p1) as an exercise proxy
candidates.reason_rejected: stretch was read out by western blot only; no stretched samples in GSE156667

final.assay: bulk polyA RNA-seq, HiSeq 4000, Cufflinks/Cuffdiff 2.1.0 on mm9 (S4.9.p1; GEO data_processing)
final.samples: 6 samples of the immortalized C2C12 mouse myoblast cell line differentiated to myotubes in culture: 3 WT (C2C12WT1-3) and 3 CRISPR Lrrc8a KO (C2C12KO1-3), basal culture conditions (GEO overall_design; FIG1 legend n = 3 each)
final.primary_estimand: Effect of Lrrc8a (SWELL1) gene deletion on gene expression in differentiated C2C12 myotubes in vitro (S2.2.p1). No exercise estimand: the sequenced samples are a cell line with no exercise, training, contraction or stretch arm.
planned_contrasts: Lrrc8a KO vs WT C2C12 myotubes (S2.2.p1, FIG1 D-F; Supplementary file 1) — genotype contrast, not exercise
final.exercise_in_paper: Only a treadmill exercise-tolerance test of skeletal-muscle Lrrc8a KO vs WT mice as a phenotype readout (S4.19.p1; ABS.p1 'reduced exercise endurance'); no tissue from it was sequenced. Stretch stimulation (S4.12.p1) was read out by western blot only.
final.repeated_measure_unit: none (independent culture replicates of two isogenic cell lines)
final.paper_method: Cufflinks Assembly and DE (Cuffdiff) v2.1.0 on FPKM (S4.9.p1)
final.paper_results: No total DEG count stated; heatmap of top 17 DEGs (FIG1 D); named genes Mef2a, Myl2, Myl3, Myl4, Actc1, Tnnc2, Igf2 down; Ppargc1a, Pparg up; Akt2, Slc2a4, Foxo3/4/6 down (S2.2.p1, S2.3.p1)

reasoning: The paper deposits one RNA-seq series, GSE156667 (DA.p1, DA.p3), described as WT vs Lrrc8a KO differentiated C2C12 myotubes (S2.2.p1, S4.9.p1). GEO confirms 6 cell-line samples whose only varying field is genotype. Exercise appears only as an in vivo treadmill endurance phenotype (S4.19.p1) with no transcriptomic readout. The paper's own estimand for these data is a genotype effect in cultured cells; no sample subset or contrast in this accession can estimate how exercise affects gene expression. Recasting KO vs WT as an exercise effect would manufacture an estimand the paper does not test. The case is refused here because the paper itself, confirmed by GEO metadata, rules out an exercise contrast; later gates would not change this.
stop_reason: GSE156667 contains only WT vs Lrrc8a-KO C2C12 myotubes under basal culture (genotype contrast); no exercise, training or contraction arm exists in the sequenced data, so the exercise estimand is not identifiable.
